query: Why do some travel expenses get declined, and which factors contribute the most?

per_column.name: is_travel_related
per_column.rationale: Restates the query's scope filter (travel expenses) rather than proposing a causal driver of declines; a selection/scope flag, not a treatment or confounder.

per_column.name: expense_category_type
per_column.rationale: Expense type plausibly affects both how an expense is entered/handled (treatment-side) and the likelihood of decline, so it is a plausible common cause; not explicitly named in query.

per_column.name: asset_class
per_column.rationale: The kind of item purchased can influence both procurement/entry path and approval outcome; a plausible surfaced common cause.

per_column.name: entry_method
per_column.rationale: The candidate cause whose effect on declines is being attributed: manual vs automated registration is a manipulable process variable plausibly driving approval outcomes.

per_column.name: has_source_id
per_column.rationale: Presence of a source id is largely a downstream consequence of entry method / processing, likely on the path to decline rather than a common cause; adjusting for it risks mediator bias.

per_column.name: ci_specificity
per_column.rationale: Quality/specificity of the CI descriptor is a consequence of how the record was entered, sitting on the path from entry method to decline; more mediator than common cause.

per_column.name: processing_lag_band
per_column.rationale: Processing lag is downstream of both the record and its handling/outcome (declined items may not be processed); conditioning on it risks collider/mediator bias, not a valid confounder.

per_column.name: department_confounder
per_column.rationale: Department plausibly causes both entry practices and decline rates, a genuine common cause; however 'department' is already present in the original table and effectively named, so not novel surfacing.

judge.rationale: A plausible treatment (entry_method) is present, and a few added columns (expense_category_type, asset_class) qualify as genuinely surfaced common causes not named in the query. However, department is a relabelled existing column that is effectively named, and several columns (has_source_id, ci_specificity, processing_lag_band) are mediators/colliders downstream of entry/processing rather than confounders -- adjusting for them would bias attribution. is_travel_related merely restates query scope. Only a partial realisation of causal-attribution structure with mixed confounder quality.
